rationale: The plan correctly identifies the data as RSEM expected counts in a gene-level matrix, asks for the per-sample genes.results files, and when absent fits DESeq2 Wald (after explicit rounding) and edgeR QL (on fractional counts) with no length offset, no TPM/FPKM substitution, and the lost offset carried as a stated limitation; it omits only the tximport type-rsem detail about zero effective lengths. QC keeps sample_01 with blind-VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes and detected genes and an explicit keep/remove policy. The pre-filter (>=10 in >=6 samples plus independent filtering), in-model normalization, ~condition with control as reference and a named contrast, BH at 0.05 with apeglm and no post-hoc LFC filtering are all explicit and correct for an unpaired single-batch two-group design. Enrichment is correctly omitted and the report specifies versions, design, thresholds, tested/DE counts, sessionInfo and both data caveats.
